rows.question: Why does a surfer in a black wetsuit squat on a white surfboard?
rows.prediction: A surfer in a black wetsuit squatting on a white surfboard is likely in the process of catching a wave. When a surfer catches a wave, they need to quickly adjust their body position to maintain balance and control on the surfboard. Squatting is a common position for surfers to adopt when they are in the process of catching a wave, as it helps them lower their center of gravity and maintain stability. Additionally, squatting allows the surfer to quickly paddle and gain momentum to match the speed of the wave. Once the wave is caught, the surfer will stand up on the surfboard to ride it.
